description: Source code for account-related models and logic in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including account hierarchy, move, currency, and account template classes.

classes.name: account_account
classes.description: Model extending account.account with custom fields and methods for hierarchy, total computation, and balance handling.

classes.name: account_move
classes.description: Model extending account.move with additional fields for narration.

classes.name: res_currency
classes.description: Model extending res.currency with a sub_name field and default value.

classes.name: account_account_template
classes.description: Model extending account.account.template with a custom 'type1' selection field.

methods.name: _get_level
methods.description: Calculates the hierarchy level of an account based on its parent.

methods.name: _get_children_and_consol
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all child account IDs for consolidation.

methods.name: compute_total
methods.description: Computes total balances within specified date ranges.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account, with checks for duplicate names and initial balance handling.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates account details, including balance adjustments and move line updates.

methods.name: onchange_type
methods.description: Determines account type ('dr', 'cr', 'none') based on account type.
